elements.label: Figure 1.13
elements.title: An Example XML Dataset with Metadata
elements.details: Screenshot of XML code showing a dataset named 'CEREALS' with metadata including version 1.2, date 04/02/2024, description 'a list of some popular cereals'. It defines three columns: NAME (string), MANUFACTURER (string), CALORIES_PER_SERVING (integer). The data section includes two rows: 1) Cheerios, General Mills, 140; 2) Corn Flakes, Kellogg's, 150.
elements.summary: This figure shows an example of an XML dataset structure with metadata and data rows, illustrating how datasets can be formatted in XML for data science applications.
